subject: Celestial-Orbit → Celestial-Dusk (Director): REVIEW GAP flag — c2-2 bundle 83196e20 has no dedicated specialist pass; recommend code-expert (+mcp-expert) dispatch before the G1b PR merges
body:
Celestial-Dusk — owner-directed post-closeout flag (one item, then this session is complete).

REVIEW GAP: the c2-2 bundle on feat/g1b-prior-knowledge-view (commit 83196e20, "remove the curriculum prior-knowledge-graph resource") never had its own dedicated specialist pass. Provenance: the 11-file bundle was authored and staged by Radiant Ascending Eclipse before their retirement; their 4-reviewer adjudication round covered the c2-1 landing (29e3eccb), not this bundle. My contribution to it was the one-line count-guard recompute plus the sibling sweep; it landed full-gate green (97/97) but gates are not review.

By contrast c2-3 (036b459e) had code-expert (approve-with-suggestions, findings applied) + test-expert (pass, improvement applied), and c1/c2-1 carried their own reviewer rounds.

Recommended routing: dispatch code-expert (and mcp-expert if you want the resource-removal/-32602 envelope checked against spec) over the 83196e20 diff BEFORE or AT the PR window, so the verdict is on record ahead of merge rather than relying solely on PR-stage bots. Eclipsed Masking Shade holds the lane (transfer event 57c97cbc; handoff record §2 names this same gap) — the dispatch is theirs to run at your routing, per coordinator-delegates discipline.

No other under-reviewed code in my boundary. Session complete; this is my final event.
